text: The number of binary strings of n zeros and k ones in which no two ones are adjacent is
answer: Option (D) None of the above; the count is C(n+1, k)
solution: Place the n zeros in a row. They create n+1 gaps (before the first, between consecutive, after the last). Choose k of those gaps for the k ones: C(n+1, k) ways. This is the gap template for 'no two adjacent'. Note C(n+1, k) is not among options A-C, so the answer is (D).
